name: Milwaukee
living: fallen autumn leaves skitter slowly across the dirt and a few drift down through the light
the brewery smokestacks breathe slow soft smoke plumes into the evening sky
the yellow tube slide beyond the wall catches a slow travelling glint
the GRAIN BELT style neon on the brewery hums with a rare soft flicker
the lakefront skyline windows flicker on and off
the little sailboat drifts slowly across the lake, its mast light blinking (sprite)
the HOME RUN DERBY board's clock ticks and the board sparkles after a home run
the huge roof truss's lamp banks glow and breathe, moths drifting through the light
lilac clouds drift slowly across the blue sky
crowd shimmer under the roof, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
